All 9 tests now pass (`node --test`). I changed only the source files, not the tests.

There were two bugs:

1. **`src/bill.js`, `splitBill`:** The leftover-cent check was `i <= leftover`, which is off by one. It gave one extra cent to `leftover + 1` people, so the total no longer matched the bill. For example, `splitBill(900, 3)` returned `[301, 300, 300]`. I changed it to `i < leftover`.
2. **`src/duration.js`, `parseDuration`:** The code only looked for `<digits><unit>` pieces anywhere in the string and ignored the rest. `"10m and change"` was therefore accepted as 10 minutes. It now also requires the whole string to match `^(\d+[hms])+$`, and throws a `SyntaxError` otherwise.

Each fix is a single line.
